## Engineering Core Philosophy
1. **Evidence Before Confidence**: Output must trace back to vector retrieval, knowledge graphs, or explicit mathematical proofs rather than ungrounded model hallucinations.
2. **Deterministic Where It Matters**: Guardrails, release gates, accounting math, optimization solvers, and validation schemas must be deterministic; models handle linguistic transformation and structured entity extraction.
3. **Human Review for Consequential Actions**: Consequential mutations (dispatching municipal crews, sending escalation notices, altering calendars, modifying databases) require explicit human review states, permission scopes, and immutable audit logs.
4. **Evaluation Over Vibes**: Rigorous deterministic test harnesses (retrieval recall, concept extraction accuracy, gate precision, arithmetic error) over subjective demo reviews.

## Flagship Systems & Case Studies (13 Production Systems)

### 01. Civitas — Multimodal Civic Incident Intelligence System
- **Focus**: Omnichannel civic intake pipeline converting citizen reports across Web PWA, WhatsApp, Telegram, and Open311 into policy-grounded municipal work orders.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js 16, React 19, FastAPI, PostGIS, H3 Hexagonal Spatial Index, LangGraph, Groq, CLIP, Leaflet.
- **Key Architecture**: Client-side canvas downsampling (40MB to <1.2MB in <200ms), H3 Res 8/9 hotspot clustering, BM25+Dense RRF policy routing ($k=60$, 99.2% accuracy), 64-bit dHash anti-fraud verification, SHA-256 audit seals.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Dhruvg334/civitas
- **Live App**: https://civitas-web.vercel.app

### 02. Mnemos — Industrial Knowledge Intelligence & GraphRAG
- **Focus**: Asset-centric operational memory platform turning fragmented maintenance records, manuals, and sensor logs into verifiable root-cause diagnostics.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js 16, React 19, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, pgvector, Neo4j, Redis, LangGraph, Docker.
- **Key Architecture**: Asset hierarchy resolution, hybrid vector/lexical/graph retrieval, 11-stage LangGraph supervisor, durable review pauses in PostgreSQL for critical actions.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Dhruvg334/Mnemos
- **Live App**: https://mnemos-lake.vercel.app

### 03. A-DAP-T — Static AI-Agent Security Review Platform
- **Focus**: Pre-release AST audit scanner for agentic applications surfacing risky tools, missing approval gates, prompt injection risks, and credential exposures.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js, React 19, TypeScript, FastAPI, Python 3.12, AST Parser, Firebase Auth, Gemini API.
- **Key Architecture**: 100% static text and AST inspection with zero code execution, 16-point guardrail verification matrix, tri-state release gates (BLOCK / REVIEW / ALLOW).
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Dhruvg334/A-DAP-T
- **Live App**: https://a-dap-t.vercel.app

### 04. ChronOS — Adaptive Execution & Constraint-Aware Planning
- **Focus**: Personal capacity and schedule solver parsing brain dumps into non-overlapping calendar events with two-way Google Calendar synchronization.
- **Tech Stack**: React 19, Vite, TypeScript, FastAPI, Python 3.12, Supabase, pgvector, Google Calendar API.
- **Key Architecture**: Topological collision-free interval packing, 158 backend + 37 frontend tests, reversible sync transactions with rollback receipts.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Dhruvg334/Chronos
- **Live App**: https://chronos-dhruv.netlify.app

### 05. Tessarion — Graph-Grounded Learning & Evaluation Platform
- **Focus**: Source-grounded active recall learning suite using prerequisite knowledge graphs, teach-back diagnostics, and automated regression test harnesses.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Supabase, Neo4j, Qdrant, Cytoscape.js, Vitest.
- **Key Architecture**: Neo4j prerequisite DAG, misconception classification, 50+ automated Vitest test cases, 100% textbook source citation linking.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Dhruvg334/Tessarion

### 06. Carbonly — Auditable Carbon Intelligence & Decarbonization Platform
- **Focus**: Enterprise GHG Protocol accounting engine delivering deterministic Scope 1/2/3 calculations, time-series competition, and linear programming budget optimization.
- **Tech Stack**: Node.js, Express 5, JavaScript, FastAPI, Groq LLaMA-3.3-70B, Primal Simplex LP, Gauss-Jordan Inversion, Netlify, Render.
- **Key Architecture**: Decoupled deterministic engine ($0.000000\text{ kg}$ error), 5x5 Gauss-Jordan Mahalanobis matrix anomaly detection, 10,000-iteration Monte Carlo uncertainty, Primal Simplex solver.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Dhruvg334/Carbonly
- **Live App**: https://carbonlyai.netlify.app/

### 11. Shodhak — Regional Adventure Discovery & Gemini Itinerary Platform

### 12. NewsPortal — Multi-Engine Misinformation & Fact-Check Platform
- **Focus**: News intelligence platform combining multi-dataset ML ensembles, live Google Fact Check API retrieval, NLI claim verification, and reader personalization.
- **Tech Stack**: React 19, Vite 7, Node.js, Express 5, FastAPI, Python 3.12, MongoDB, DistilBERT, Google Fact Check Tools API.
- **Key Architecture**: Dataset-specific ML ensembles (WELFake, LIAR, ISOT) with DistilBERT transformer models, NLI support/contradiction analysis, exploration vs exploitation recommender.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Dhruvg334/NewsPortal

### 13. Niswarth AI — NGO Governance & Autonomous Fiscal Auditor
- **Focus**: Non-profit document intelligence and compliance platform extracting fiscal entities from receipts, verifying bylaws, and generating audit-ready impact reports.
- **Tech Stack**: Python, FastAPI, LangGraph, PostgreSQL, pgvector, Docker, React 19, TypeScript.
- **Key Architecture**: Multi-agent LangGraph supervisor (Fiscal Auditor + Regulatory Bylaw agents), deterministic ledger math, PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) tenant isolation, SHA-256 seal.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Dhruvg334/Niswarth-AI
